top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a simple, new chemical idea (a small molecule recruits an E3 ligase to a chosen protein) that is independently confirmed, mechanistically explained through ternary-complex and cereblon structures, and has opened previously undruggable targets. Crews, Deshaies and Handa give a coherent three-name allocation with one citation covering PROTACs and glues; the missing approved PROTAC drug and the excluded Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim and Ito are real weaknesses, but the strongest case remains here.
